name: smwmusic-jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-diamond-is-unbreakable-chase-opening
title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable - Chase ~ Opening 2 (Remix)
description:
𝐕𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲. 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐭'𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐲 𝐈'𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮.

Yes, I did a remix of Chase from Jojo's Bizarre Adventure (Part 4): Diamond is Unbreakable. You're not seeing things. It's my favorite of the Jojo OP themes and is by far one of the most underrated ones in the series. The hard rock combined with the deep emotion set piece really sets the mood for the entire song. Note, this isn't the actual full song and is just based on the OP version, since doing the full song would take up so much ARAM.

This baby can fit title screens, credits, [final] boss fights, intense stages, final areas, and castle / towers stages.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" is disabled.

There's also an option to enable or disable the loop in the song file with an ending like in the OP:
1. Loops the song (turned on by default).
2. No Loop
